Our behavioral model

Three kinds of insight, one behavioral model

Predikta brings together the what, the why and the how of Filipino behavior. Each layer feeds the others, so every result comes with the reason behind it.

  1. The what · Proprietary dataWhat Filipinos believe and live through

    Our own nationwide, in-person survey, modeled into 69.8M psychographic profiles.

  2. The why · Behavioral scienceWhy people think, feel and act

    Validated frameworks read each profile’s personality, values, emotions and biases.

  3. The how · AI simulationHow they are likely to respond

    Behavioral AI agents carry each profile and react in character to your ad, offer or idea.

The what, the why and the how, working as one model.

Cost of research

Market research in the Philippines, at a fraction of the cost.

One face-to-face study takes 4–6 weeks and costs ₱1.5M–₱2.5M, so most ideas launch untested. Predikta shows how 69.8M modeled Filipino profiles are likely to respond, in minutes, without recruiting respondents or conducting new fieldwork.

FAQ

Your questions, answered

Can’t find what you need?

Try your campaign

Predikta is Netopia AI’s behavioral simulation platform, built on how 69.8 million Filipinos think, feel and decide. It shows how modeled Filipino audiences are likely to respond to an ad, offer or idea before launch, and why. The entire Filipino market, on call.

Pick an audience, add your campaign context, and test your customer-facing copy or concept. Behavioral AI agents, each carrying a real survey profile, respond in character. You get six scores by segment, from appeal to purchase intent, each with a written reason. It works like a dynamic survey: change the ad, offer or audience, and ask again.

From Netopia AI’s own in-person survey across all 18 regions (fielded in Q4 2024, ±1.97% margin of error), modeled into 69.8M psychographic profiles: a whole nation, simulated. It covers personality, values, beliefs, emotions and attitudes. It is not scraped or licensed data.

In published tests, simulated Filipinos matched real survey answers 92% of the time, with 88% sentiment accuracy at the national level (arXiv 2505.22125). In a blind backtest of 200 real ads with AdSpark, the ads Predikta ranked in its top 20% earned a 3.4× higher click-through rate and a 2.6× lower cost per click than the bottom 80%. Predikta shows what is most likely to perform; it doesn’t guarantee results.

A general chatbot answers like the internet: one averaged opinion, mostly from non-Filipino text. Predikta answers from a defined Filipino audience: thousands of Behavioral AI agents, each with a real survey profile, scored by segment and checked in accuracy tests and a blind backtest.

Building and profiling audiences (including your own customers through MAP ME), asking a modeled segment U&A-style questions, testing campaigns before launch, and reading live comments after launch with Listen.

No. Test ideas in minutes, then use fieldwork or live A/B tests to validate the strongest options.

Get research-grade insights in minutes, at a fraction of the fieldwork cost. To see how Predikta works, a free quick run returns 10 responses.
